title: Sonobudoyo Museum
scope: The standing historic Unit I core across from the north square: the 1935 Thomas Karsten building, small receiving pavilion, main gate and rear gallery, western secretariat and 1941 range, along with the eastern Pendapa Kesenian and the frontage. Modern galleries, museum exhibits and Unit II are separate.
limitations: The current map controls the site and roof envelopes. Heights, exact roof pitch, wood joinery, painted moldings and back elevations are estimated.
The model focuses on the surviving historic visitor complex. Modern exhibit buildings, the distinct Unit II, and secondary buildings outside the modeled yard are outside this geometry.
White masonry frontage and orange clay roofs are supported by the public-domain image. Sculptures, distinctive modern lettering and decorative panel artwork were excluded.
next: Create five heritage ranges, the raised tiered pavilions, and the three openings of the southern frontage.
